caption:
Japan's 55,000 convenience stores are not gas stations. They're infrastructure.

7-Eleven ATMs accept foreign cards for ¥110 during the day. Always pick JPY on screen, never your home currency. Dynamic currency conversion costs you every time. Withdraw once a week, save ¥4,840/month in fees.

Lawson's Uchi Café runs ¥110-150. Starbucks is ¥400+. That's ¥7,500/month if you drink daily. The konbini version is good.

Need to print a visa document at 11PM? Every konbini has a multifunction printer. Netprint app, upload, print. ¥10-20 per page.

Traveling between cities? Drop your suitcase at the counter. Takkyubin ships it in 1-3 days for ¥1,500-3,000. You move with just a day pack.

And the food: onigiri + salad + drink for ¥750. After 8PM, discounts hit 10-50%. Seasonal shelf rotates constantly. Winter oden, spring strawberry, summer kakigori.
